content:
alana: Quick heads-up: we're cutting the miniroot rebase + unprivileged runtime change today 18:00 PT. Need RBAC preflight, KMS key prep, audit sink smoke. Who's on it? :wave:
nate: I'll own RBAC and canary gating. Which SAs and bindings change?
alana: runtime-runner, image-batch, signer-service. Plan: drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN from runtime-runner, move signer to signer-service-role with limited list/sign only.
marco: I'll do vuln triage on the init-image we plan to use. We swapped to busybox-init:1.2 — quick scan first.
devin: I'll prepare KMS alias rotation and cosign verification steps. Dry-run in staging before prod swap.
natalie: I'll run audit-forwarding checks to datadog and the SIEM; will produce sample events.
sec-bot: automated: created ticket SEC-8599 and checklist https://redwood-internal/runbooks/miniroot-unpriv-cutover
ops-oncall: I'll be on-call during cutover window 18:00-19:00 PT. Will open #incident if error rate > 3x baseline.
nate: RBAC preflight commands I'll run:```sh
kubectl get clusterrolebinding signer-service-role -o yaml
kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-runner use evict
```
marco: vuln scan result (quick): busybox-init:1.2 flagged CVE-2023-xxxx in busybox ash binary. Low severity but it's in init image. Will validate exploitability.
alana: Hmm — prefer not to ship until init image is clean. Options: 1) patch init image and rebase 2) use existing privileged init for only canary 3) add mitigations in runtime e.g. seccomp. What's easiest?
marco: Mitigation 1 takes ~30m to produce patched build + cosign sign. Mitigation 2 is faster but keeps a privileged init in prod, reducing blast radius. I recommend patch now for long term; for today we can canary with privileged-init and strict monitoring.
devin: KMS dry-run: will create ephemeral wrapping key, wrap cosign private key, push wrapped key to staging keystore alias miniroot-signer-staging. Cosign verify command:```sh
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign verify --key k8s://secret/keystore/staging/miniroot-signer-pub.pem ghcr.io/redwood/miniroot:canary
```
natalie: Audit fields to assert: principal, requestURI, pod.name, image.digest, cosign.attestation.id. I'll grep for trace id mr-4278881234.
sec-bot: automated: checklist status: [RBAC:false] [Audit:false] [KMS-dryrun:false] [Vuln-scan:false]
(12 minutes later) marco: Full vuln triage: the busybox CVE requires local write to /tmp inside init, we run init as root but with no network. Exploit risk low. Patch ETA 45m.
nate: RBAC canary applied in staging: removed CAP_SYS_ADMIN from runtime-runner SA. Ran e2e -> pod starts fail with cgroup error.
marco: that cgroup mount error is the same we've seen before. Init needs to move cgroup v2 handles.
alana: For canary in prod we'll keep privileged init for now. Update runbook to call this out and ensure audit logging captures init PID and image name.
ops-oncall: Agreed. I'll provision a tighter WAF rule and monitor: if we'll see >5 failed mounts log flood, I'll cut traffic.
devin: KMS staging wrap done, cosign verify OK. Output snippet:```txt
Verification for ghcr.io/redwood/miniroot:canary -- OK
Signed by: CN=miniroot-signer
```
natalie: Staging audit-forwarder: events found with trace mr-4278881234. Sample field set: request.user=system:serviceaccount:runtime:runtime-runner, init.image=ghcr.io/redwood/busybox-init:1.2, cosign.attestation=true.
sec-bot: automated: created ephemeral changelog entry and pinned runbook step for privileged-init fallback.
marco: Since busybox patch ETA ~45m, decision: proceed with prod canary using privileged init, then ship patched init + re-sign tomorrow. Thoughts?
nate: OK for canary only. RBAC preflight must include an explicit allow for init SA to run privileged and then revoke post-cutover. I'll prepare RoleBinding with TTL via automation.
alana: Agreed. Take the canary, monitor, and revert if anything odd. Devin, start prod KMS rotation after canary green.
devin: KMS: will perform key wrap push after canary pass. If we need to revert signature, we'll restore keystore alias to previous wrapped key (we keep backup). Command to list aliases:```sh
kubectl -n keystore get secret | grep miniroot-signer
```
(After prod canary at 18:00) natalie: Can confirm prod canary: audit events show init ran privileged: true for the canary pod, but main container showed no caps. No elevated execs. Timestamp offsets ~3s.
marco: Post-canary vuln note: exploitability requires adding network egress. Since init had no egress, risk acceptable for short window.
ops-oncall: Observability: error rate stable. No incident opened. Rolling to full at 18:20 if no regressions.
devin: Performing prod keystore swap now (wrap key push). cosign verify again after push.```txt
Verification for ghcr.io/redwood/miniroot:canary -- OK
Signed by: CN=miniroot-signer
```
sec-bot: automated: post-deploy checklist updated: [RBAC:true] [Audit:true] [KMS-dryrun:true] [Vuln-scan:deferred-patch]
alana: Follow-ups: 1) patch init image and re-sign tomorrow 2) revoke privileged-init via automation 3) confirm audit retention & forwarder metrics 4) update release notes with mitigations. Thanks all. :heart:
marco: I'll create SEC-8601 to track init patch and assign to release engineers.
nate: I'll schedule RBAC revoke job 24h after full rollout unless rollback.
ops-oncall: Leaving monitoring on for 24h. Ping me for any anomaly.
sec-bot: automated: closing this run's checklist; see SEC-8599 for details.
